title: BCAB 2006 - Fire separation of residential roof-top decks

facts.text: The project is the design and construction of a new three-unit rowhouse under Part 9. The building will be sprinklered, and will contain no stacked units or secondary suites. During the project, the property will be subdivided into three parcels; property lines will be added between units and the walls between units will be party walls.
Each of the three units will have an exterior rooftop deck accessed by an internal stair leading up from the storey below. A 1.8m high privacy screen is located between two of the roof decks.
